item.title: Bulletin updated at 12:10 HKT 14/Oct/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of an anticyclone aloft, the weather will be mainly fine and hot over Guangdong for the rest of this week. The northeast monsoon is expected to reach southern China on Sunday. An area of low pressure will gradually develop over the seas east of the Philippines in the latter part of this week, and move across the vicinity of Luzon over the weekend, with a higher chance of entering the South China Sea subsequently. However, there are uncertainties in its movement and intensity. Under the combined effect of the northeast monsoon and the low pressure system, it will be windy with a few showers and temperatures will fall appreciably over the coast of southern China early to midweek next week.
